fields.summary_ko.0: TSMC (TSM) October revenue surged to NT$58.689B ($17.85B), up 59.7% YoY, as AI chip production remains strong, lifting stock price.
fields.summary_ko.1: As the world's largest contract chip manufacturer, TSMC's monthly revenue also increased 14.7% MoM, strengthening its position as a key beneficiary of AI demand.
